KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.

2. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

3. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.

4. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.

5. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

6. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

7. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mato
   C. watoto
   D. mitoto

8. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.

9. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. fupi
   C. nene
   D. pana

10. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
